answer: Each comet is admitted to the forge only after earning 100 summit, at most one summit per epoch, each awarded when randomly drawn judges score its novel task output. The forge embeds every submission, so clones run by one operator collide there: the k-th comet whose work clusters with earlier ones must earn 100·k² summit, still one per epoch. An honest comet waits 100 epochs; a farm's 1,000th clone waits 100 million epochs, and no parallelism helps. It breaks if outputs can be cheaply decorrelated or judges bribed.
